messages:
Jamie: Morning chaos alert 
There is a sticky note mosaic on the lobby sculpture and someone wrote 'Post-it Overlord' on top.
Rory: Wait what 
Is this a prank or performance art?
Samira: I saw it at 8:12. Brilliant use of neon. Whoever did it has craftsmanship.
Kofi: That was me. Confession: midnight creativity session + too much coffee. My bad on the glue residue.
Anya: Kofi! Legend. Also FacilitiesBot fyi: we need to check if the adhesive left marks.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder: please avoid taping or sticking items directly to property. If you want to decorate, submit a temporary display request.
Kofi: Apologies, Facilities. I'll bring cleaning supplies and make a display request.
Jamie: Proposal: make this a sanctioned micro-ceremony called "Sticky Wednesday". Low-effort, high morale.
Rory: Vote yes. We can have rotating 'Artful Note' winners. Small prize: a pack of fancy Post-its.
Samira: Prize idea: one golden Post-it (laminated) to be pinned on the person-of-the-week board.
Anya: Lore idea: the person who sticks the golden Post-it is given the honorary nickname "Post-it Overlord" for 24h.
Kofi: I'm honored, but I will be humble. Also offering to remove residue and restore the sculpture.
FacilitiesBot: Thank you Kofi. If residue persists, please coordinate via facilities@redwood.com.
Jamie: Cultural add-on: we should document the origin story. The "Great Sticky Note Heist" will be a short Slack thread + one photo in the culture album.
Rory: I'll take pics. Can we add a silly plaque beside the sculpture: "Do not feed after midnight"?
Samira: Plaque approved. Also let's keep it eco-friendlyno glitter, biodegradable paper.
Anya: CultureTeam: if we formalize Sticky Wednesday, can we get bulk Post-its added to office supply orders?
CultureTeam: Noted. If there's uptake, we'll budget for one pack per week. Low-cost, high vibes.
Kofi: I promise the next mosaic will be a tasteful color palette and not a ransom-note collage.
Jamie: Governance question: is sticker art eligible for the monthly kudos awards?
Rory: Absolutely. Creativity is a form of service.
Samira: Can we include a short blurb in this week's newsletter: "Meet the Post-it Overlord"?
CultureTeam: Will draft a 1-line blurb and include photos. Also will add a gentle reminder about property rules.
FacilitiesBot: Note: temporary office art displays are fine if pre-approved; please avoid adhesives that may damage surfaces.
Anya: Kofi cleaning update: removed residue, used citrus cleaner, sculpture intact. Kofi is my hero.
Kofi: Cleanup complete. Leaving a tiny Post-it trail to the recycling bin as an apology offering.
Jamie: Vote to make Sticky Wednesday a recurring micro-tradition: reactions count. :thumbsup: means yes.
Rory: Already reacted. Long live Post-it Overlord.
Samira: This is officially documented as "The Great Sticky Note Heist" in my head.
CultureTeam: We'll add a short entry to the culture vault and include a harmless celebratory sticker pack for next week.
Jamie: Excellent. Photo ops later. If anyone has a sticky note haiku, drop it here.
Rory: Haiku: "Neon squares whisper / Midnight hands rearrange calm / Walls wear bright secrets"
Samira: Too poetic for a sticky note but I love it.
Jamie: Closing note: thanks to Facilities and to Kofi for cleaning. Tradition established. No sculptures were harmed in the making of lore.
